001.speaker: GHOST
001.text: Come on. Come on. Where are you?
where: CS1 Cosmodrome revive

002.speaker: GHOST
002.text: There. The signal is faint, but it is there.
where: CS1 Cosmodrome revive

003.speaker: GHOST
003.text: Found you. You have been out here a very long time.
where: CS1 Cosmodrome revive

004.speaker: GHOST
004.text: I do not know if this will work. I just know I am not leaving you.
where: CS1 Cosmodrome revive

005.speaker: GHOST
where: CS1 Cosmodrome revive

006.speaker: GHOST
006.text: There it is. The Last City. And the Traveler, right where we left it.
where: CS2 Tower arrival

007.speaker: GHOST
007.text: Take your time. Look around. Everything is going to feel new.
where: CS2 Tower arrival

008.speaker: GHOST
008.text: The Vanguard are waiting. Come on.
where: CS2 Tower arrival

009.speaker: GHOST
009.text: Look at this Glimmer from the Devils' Lair. The data signature is Cabal.
where: CS3 Glimmer shown to the Vanguard

010.speaker: GHOST
010.text: She knows more than she is saying.
where: CS6 Throne room

011.speaker: GHOST
011.text: Sparks. Wires. There is nothing inside.
where: CS7 Calus unmasked

012.speaker: ZAVALA
where: CS3 Glimmer shown to the Vanguard

013.speaker: IKORA REY
where: CS3 Glimmer shown to the Vanguard

014.speaker: CAYDE-6
014.text: Cabal money in Fallen pockets. That is never good news.
where: CS3 Glimmer shown to the Vanguard

015.speaker: CROTA
015.text: My father will hear of this.
where: CS4 Crota dies

016.speaker: PETRA VENJ
016.text: My Queen. The Guardian you asked for.
where: CS6 Throne room

017.speaker: MARA SOV
017.text: So this is the one the Light chose. Welcome to the Dreaming City, Guardian.
where: CS6 Throne room

018.speaker: MARA SOV
018.text: The Taken have broken through the Mists. Oryx's children nest where they should never be.
where: CS6 Throne room

019.speaker: MARA SOV
019.text: Climb the Spine of Keres and prove yourself. Then we will speak of the Emperor.
where: CS6 Throne room

020.speaker: EMPEROR CALUS
020.text: Impressive. But do not mourn the shell.
where: CS7 Calus unmasked

100.speaker: GHOST
100.text: I'm your Ghost. I know this must be confusing - but trust me, we need to move.
where: Mission e1 A Guardian Rises / Mission start

101.speaker: GHOST
101.text: This is the Cosmodrome. There's Fallen everywhere, stay low.
where: Mission e1 A Guardian Rises / Mission start

102.speaker: GHOST
102.text: The House of Devils! Watch out!
where: Mission e1 A Guardian Rises / Zone 1 begins

103.speaker: GHOST
where: Mission e1 A Guardian Rises / Boss zone activates

104.speaker: GHOST
104.text: That was enough action for today. Let's go home.
where: Mission e1 A Guardian Rises / Mission end (cache opened)

105.speaker: GHOST
105.text: Rasputin's old array. This will help boost our communications with other planets.
where: Mission e2 The Last Array / Mission start

106.speaker: GHOST
106.text: Three relay consoles. Get me close and I can get them online.
where: Mission e2 The Last Array / Zone 2 begins

107.speaker: GHOST
107.text: It's a servitor! And a big one too. It must be jamming the array. We need to take it down!
where: Mission e2 The Last Array / Boss zone activates

108.speaker: GHOST
108.text: The Glimmer they're dropping, it has a data signature. I'm looking into this now.
where: Mission e3 The Devils' Lair / Zone 2 begins

109.speaker: GHOST
109.text: It's Cabal in origin. I don't know what's going on, but I don't like it.
where: Mission e3 The Devils' Lair / Zone 2 cleared

110.speaker: GHOST
110.text: This is their Kell! It's time for him to fall.
where: Mission e3 The Devils' Lair / Boss zone activates

111.speaker: GHOST
111.text: Great job Guardian. Cabal and Fallen working together cannot be good news. We need to tell the Vanguard.
where: Mission e3 The Devils' Lair / Mission end (cache opened)

112.speaker: GHOST
112.text: A Ghost shell. it's... broken. We need to pick it up.
where: Mission m1 The Dark Beyond / Zone 2 begins

113.speaker: GHOST
113.text: These Hive are not normal. They have royal crests in their Chitin.
where: Mission m1 The Dark Beyond / Boss zone activates

114.speaker: GHOST
114.text: Rite totems. They are feeding Omnigul. Break them.
where: Mission m2 Chamber of Night / Zone 2 begins

115.speaker: GHOST
115.text: It's Omnigul. She must fall Guardian!
where: Mission m2 Chamber of Night / Boss zone activates

116.speaker: GHOST
116.text: They know we are coming. We killed their commander. I don't think they're happy about that.
where: Mission m3 Crota's End / Zone 2 begins

117.speaker: GHOST
117.text: That's a big sword. Don't let him get close!
where: Mission m3 Crota's End / Boss zone activates

118.speaker: GHOST
118.text: I think he said "my father will hear of this". I don't know who his father is, but that cannot be good.
where: Mission m3 Crota's End / Mission end (cache opened)

119.speaker: GHOST
119.text: We need to translate what he said. Stand by that terminal while I figure out what's going on.
where: Mission r1 The Buried City / Zone 2 begins

120.speaker: GHOST
120.text: The Red Legion are sieging one of Rasputin's bunkers. He asked us to wipe them out.
where: Mission r1 The Buried City / Zone 2 cleared

121.speaker: GHOST
121.text: Valus Ta'aurc. Maybe he's connected to the Fallen we faced.
where: Mission r1 The Buried City / Boss zone activates

122.speaker: GHOST
122.text: Two consoles control the inner doors. Defend me while I get them open!
where: Mission r2 Dust Palace / Zone 3 begins

123.speaker: GHOST
123.text: Bracus Zahn, the Arms Dealer! Show him your power, Guardian!
where: Mission r2 Dust Palace / Boss zone activates

124.speaker: GHOST
124.text: Siege emitters. If those fire, Rasputin's bunker is compromised.
where: Mission r3 The Red War / Zone 2 begins

125.speaker: GHOST
125.text: Ghaul. The Primus of the Red Legion.
where: Mission r3 The Red War / Boss zone activates

126.speaker: GHOST
126.text: Hopefully that's the last of our Cabal troubles.
where: Mission r3 The Red War / Mission end (cache opened)

127.speaker: GHOST
127.text: Drill supports. Take them out and the whole thing comes down.
where: Mission io2 Echo Mesa / Zone 2 begins

128.speaker: GHOST
128.text: Psion Flayers! Three of them. You got this Guardian!
where: Mission io2 Echo Mesa / Boss zone activates

129.speaker: GHOST
129.text: That's the end of the Red Legion. Let's follow up with Asher Mir.
where: Mission io2 Echo Mesa / Mission end (cache opened)

130.speaker: GHOST
130.text: The Taken? No! That can't be...
where: Mission io1 Sacred Ground / Zone 2 begins

131.speaker: GHOST
131.text: That's a big captain. Watch out!
where: Mission io1 Sacred Ground / Boss zone activates

132.speaker: GHOST
132.text: The Pyramidion. The Vex have a strong presence here.
where: Mission io3 The Pyramidion / Mission start

133.speaker: GHOST
133.text: Their Mind controls the local forces on Io. We need to find it.
where: Mission io3 The Pyramidion / Mission start

134.speaker: GHOST
134.text: That data carries valuable information. We need to take it to the City.
where: Mission io3 The Pyramidion / Zone 2 begins

135.speaker: GHOST
135.text: It's the Vex mind! Take it out!
where: Mission io3 The Pyramidion / Boss zone activates

136.speaker: GHOST
136.text: Great work. We're a good team me and you!
where: Mission io3 The Pyramidion / Mission end (cache opened)

137.speaker: GHOST
137.text: Hold the gate. The survivors are coming through.
where: Mission t1 Hope / Zone 2 begins

138.speaker: GHOST
138.text: Kathok. Swordbearer. His blade is faster than it looks.
where: Mission t1 Hope / Boss zone activates

139.speaker: GHOST
139.text: The Hive aren't destroying these labs like the others... but why?
where: Mission t2 The Sunken Labs / Mission start

140.speaker: GHOST
140.text: Brood sacs. Three of them. They're growing an army!
where: Mission t2 The Sunken Labs / Zone 2 begins

141.speaker: GHOST
141.text: That has to be the Brood Mother. Take her down!
where: Mission t2 The Sunken Labs / Boss zone activates

142.speaker: GHOST
142.text: The Hive here are being strengthened by a ritual. Let's stop it.
where: Mission t3 Savathûn's Song / Mission start

143.speaker: GHOST
143.text: The ritual is being Amplified by these totems. Break them all!
where: Mission t3 Savathûn's Song / Zone 3 begins

144.speaker: GHOST
144.text: This death-song sings of one name: Savathun. We need to silence her.
where: Mission t3 Savathûn's Song / Boss zone activates

145.speaker: GHOST
145.text: Great work. I'm sure Zavala will be happy.
where: Mission t3 Savathûn's Song / Mission end (cache opened)

146.speaker: GHOST
146.text: I need to locate this Baron. Defend me while I track down his signal.
where: Mission ts1 The Trickster / Zone 2 begins

147.speaker: GHOST
where: Mission ts1 The Trickster / Boss zone activates

148.speaker: GHOST
148.text: Chains bind the ritual. Cut all three.
where: Mission ts2 The Mindbender / Zone 2 begins

149.speaker: GHOST
149.text: There he is, the Mindbender. Take him down!
where: Mission ts2 The Mindbender / Boss zone activates

150.speaker: GHOST
150.text: A salvage beacon. Hold it while the camp gathers.
where: Mission ts3 Scorned / Zone 2 begins

151.speaker: GHOST
151.text: Ether totems. Break them and the Scorn stop rising.
where: Mission ts3 Scorned / Zone 3 begins

152.speaker: GHOST
152.text: There's so many of them, be careful Guardian!
where: Mission ts3 Scorned / Boss zone activates

153.speaker: GHOST
153.text: The Divalian Mists... the stories are true. You really can't see much here.
where: Mission dc1 The Divalian Mists / Zone 1 begins

154.speaker: GHOST
154.text: Was that one of the Queen's people? It looks like an Awoken.
where: Mission dc1 The Divalian Mists / Boss zone activates

155.speaker: GHOST
155.text: I don't know what will be waiting for us up there... keep an eye out.
where: Mission dc2 The Spine of Keres / Zone 2 begins

156.speaker: GHOST
156.text: I knew this was a test. She wants us to prove ourselves.
where: Mission dc2 The Spine of Keres / Boss zone activates

157.speaker: GHOST
157.text: Blight growths. It seems to be an energy source for something.
where: Mission dc3 The Wishing Chamber / Zone 3 begins

158.speaker: GHOST
158.text: That's a real Ahamkara! We need to kill it, it's too dangerous to be left alive!
where: Mission dc3 The Wishing Chamber / Boss zone activates

159.speaker: GHOST
159.text: A throne that cannot be defeated. The Emperor?
where: Mission dc3 The Wishing Chamber / Mission end (cache opened)

160.speaker: GHOST
160.text: I have a bad feeling about this.
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Mission start

161.speaker: GHOST
161.text: Break those seals, it'll seal the doors behind us.
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Zone 3 begins

162.speaker: GHOST
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Zone 4 begins

163.speaker: GHOST
163.text: Wires? Servos? He wasn't real... just a robot?
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Boss defeated

164.speaker: GHOST
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Mission end (cache opened)

165.speaker: GHOST
165.text: You can count on us commander!
where: After io (act transition)

166.speaker: GHOST
166.text: Enough waiting. It's time to find this Emperor.
where: After dc (act transition)

167.speaker: GHOST
167.text: You can count on us, commander.
where: Tower after earth / talk to Zavala

168.speaker: GHOST
where: Tower after earth / talk to Cayde-6

169.speaker: GHOST
169.text: He has never once looked important.
where: Tower after titan / talk to Cayde-6

170.speaker: GHOST
where: Tower, all visits done

171.speaker: ZAVALA
171.text: Unknown Guardian, this is Zavala. Your Ghost sent a distress signal. Get to the wall and we will transmat you out.
where: Mission e1 A Guardian Rises / Zone 1 cleared

172.speaker: ZAVALA
172.text: The Primus of the Red Legion is here on Mars. His name is Ghaul, take him out.
where: Mission r3 The Red War / Mission start

173.speaker: ZAVALA
173.text: Titan was my home. The Hive are tearing through our Rigs.
where: Mission t1 Hope / Mission start

174.speaker: ZAVALA
174.text: Thank you. Titan will not fall.
where: Mission t1 Hope / Mission end (cache opened)

175.speaker: ZAVALA
175.text: The labs are clear. You prevented another war today. Thank you.
where: Mission t2 The Sunken Labs / Mission end (cache opened)

176.speaker: ZAVALA
176.text: Titan is under siege. My home. I need you there.
where: After io (act transition)

177.speaker: ZAVALA
177.text: A Guardian, walking out of the Cosmodrome. It has been ages. We are happy you found your way home.
where: Tower after earth / talk to Zavala

178.speaker: ZAVALA
178.text: This is the Last City. It holds, but we need help securing our place in the solar system.
where: Tower after earth / talk to Zavala

179.speaker: ZAVALA
179.text: Ghaul is dead. The Red Legion has lost its head, but it isn't gone yet.
where: Tower after mars / talk to Zavala

180.speaker: ZAVALA
180.text: Rest now, but Io awaits. The rest of the Red Legion is gathering there now, although we don't know by whose authority.
where: Tower after mars / talk to Zavala

181.speaker: ZAVALA
181.text: Titan. My home. The Hive have climbed out of the methane, and the arcology is the next to fall.
where: Tower after io / talk to Zavala

182.speaker: ZAVALA
182.text: I cannot leave the City. You can. Go, and tell them the Vanguard has not forgotten Titan.
where: Tower after io / talk to Zavala

183.speaker: ZAVALA
183.text: Guardian, you've stabilized the system. But you're not done yet.
where: Tower after dc / talk to Zavala

184.speaker: ZAVALA
184.text: This God-Emperor waits at the end of this. He must fall.
where: Tower after dc / talk to Zavala

185.speaker: ZAVALA
185.text: The City is safe tonight because of Guardians like you.
where: Tower idle chatter

186.speaker: ZAVALA
where: Tower idle chatter

187.speaker: ZAVALA
187.text: Stay vigilant. The Darkness does not rest.
where: Tower idle chatter

188.speaker: IKORA REY
188.text: The Red Legion are not a raiding party. It's a full blown invasion of Mars.
where: Mission r1 The Buried City / Mission end (cache opened)

189.speaker: IKORA REY
189.text: This command post is key to their weapons distribution. We need to take it out.
where: Mission r2 Dust Palace / Mission start

190.speaker: IKORA REY
190.text: Red Legion survivors fled to Io. But whose command do they listen to now?
where: Mission io2 Echo Mesa / Mission start

191.speaker: IKORA REY
191.text: Do not answer this invitation. We have to get the whole picture.
where: After mars (act transition)

192.speaker: IKORA REY
192.text: Your Ghost told us the glimmer found in the Devil's Lair had a Cabal data signature. Peculiar.
where: Tower after earth / talk to Ikora Rey

193.speaker: IKORA REY
193.text: Somebody is paying them. I would like to know who is paying the Fallen, and why.
where: Tower after earth / talk to Ikora Rey

194.speaker: IKORA REY
194.text: Eris Morn is a powerful ally. Thank you for securing the Hellmouth, it's where she lost her Fireteam.
where: Tower after moon / talk to Ikora Rey

195.speaker: IKORA REY
195.text: Today we remember the Guardians that fell on the moon. You did well avenging them, Guardian.
where: Tower after moon / talk to Ikora Rey

196.speaker: IKORA REY
196.text: Back in the Cosmodrome, Rasputin warned about the Cabal on Mars. When you're ready, go investigate the distress call.
where: Tower after moon / talk to Ikora Rey

197.speaker: IKORA REY
197.text: This Emperor seems to be watching you closely.
where: Tower after mars / talk to Ikora Rey

198.speaker: IKORA REY
198.text: Remember what you're fighting for. The Light, the hope of humanity. Don't answer this invitation unless it is with a fight.
where: Tower after mars / talk to Ikora Rey

199.speaker: IKORA REY
199.text: A second invitation. The Awoken Queen does nothing without a reason, and she does nothing for free.
where: Tower after tangled / talk to Ikora Rey

200.speaker: IKORA REY
200.text: The Dreaming City has been closed for a very long time. If they open it to you, you should proceed carefully.
where: Tower after tangled / talk to Ikora Rey

201.speaker: IKORA REY
201.text: Whatever this Emperor has to offer or say, don't trust him.
where: Tower after dc / talk to Ikora Rey

202.speaker: IKORA REY
202.text: Hone your abilities. You must stay sharp.
where: Tower idle chatter

203.speaker: IKORA REY
203.text: Knowledge is a weapon. Use it.
where: Tower idle chatter

204.speaker: IKORA REY
204.text: I hope your mind is as sharp as your light is.
where: Tower idle chatter

205.speaker: CAYDE-6
205.text: I brushed up on my Russian and it sounds like we need to see what the Cabal are up to on Mars. See you there kid.
where: Mission e2 The Last Array / Mission end (cache opened)

206.speaker: CAYDE-6
206.text: We need to break the House of Devils' hold on the Cosmodrome. Their Kell falls today. You got this.
where: Mission e3 The Devils' Lair / Mission start

207.speaker: CAYDE-6
207.text: The Red Legion is losing this war on Mars. We go for their leader next.
where: Mission r2 Dust Palace / Mission end (cache opened)

208.speaker: CAYDE-6
208.text: The Awoken Queen requested you? They typically aren't the friendliest people.
where: After tangled (act transition)

209.speaker: CAYDE-6
209.text: Fresh Guardian! Let me guess: the Ghost does all the talking. They always do.
where: Tower after earth / talk to Cayde-6

210.speaker: CAYDE-6
210.text: Rule one: never trust anyone who says "trust me." Except me. I am extremely trustworthy.
where: Tower after earth / talk to Cayde-6

211.speaker: CAYDE-6
211.text: The Spider says the Fallen Barons are strangling his trade on the Reef. Barons! Loud, greedy, and very very dangerous.
where: Tower after titan / talk to Cayde-6

212.speaker: CAYDE-6
212.text: I would go myself, but somebody has to stay here and look important. Hit them hard, Guardian.
where: Tower after titan / talk to Cayde-6

213.speaker: CAYDE-6
213.text: Big ship, fancy throne, a God Emperor. Classic. Shoot first, questions later.
where: Tower after dc / talk to Cayde-6

214.speaker: CAYDE-6
214.text: Come back in one piece. I have a bet on you.
where: Tower after dc / talk to Cayde-6

215.speaker: CAYDE-6
215.text: Got any spare glimmer? Asking for a friend. The friend is me.
where: Tower idle chatter

216.speaker: CAYDE-6
216.text: I would tell you a joke, but not with Ikora present.
where: Tower idle chatter

217.speaker: CAYDE-6
where: Tower idle chatter

218.speaker: PETRA VENJ
218.text: Guardian, my name is Petra. My Queen has tasked me with taking down Reksis Vahn, the Mindbender. Help me track him down.
where: Mission ts2 The Mindbender / Mission start

219.speaker: PETRA VENJ
219.text: The Queen watches. She is pleased.
where: Mission ts2 The Mindbender / Mission end (cache opened)

220.speaker: PETRA VENJ
220.text: Fikrul is the leader of them all. If he falls, his army goes with him.
where: Mission ts3 Scorned / Mission start

221.speaker: PETRA VENJ
221.text: I owe you, Guardian. Thank you for assisting the Awoken of the Reef. The Queen requests your presence.
where: Mission ts3 Scorned / Mission end (cache opened)

222.speaker: PETRA VENJ
222.text: Here we are, home. To reach the Queen we must fight through the Taken.
where: Mission dc1 The Divalian Mists / Mission start

223.speaker: PETRA VENJ
223.text: Three beacons light the way. Wake each, then hold the line!
where: Mission dc1 The Divalian Mists / Zone 2 begins

224.speaker: PETRA VENJ
224.text: The Mists are held. The Queen is on the Spine, we must go there at once.
where: Mission dc1 The Divalian Mists / Mission end (cache opened)

225.speaker: MARA SOV
225.text: Climb the Spine, Guardian. Meet me at the top.
where: Mission dc2 The Spine of Keres / Mission start

226.speaker: MARA SOV
226.text: An Emperor awaits you. He's a formidable foe. Or ally perhaps?
where: Mission dc2 The Spine of Keres / Zone 2 cleared

227.speaker: MARA SOV
227.text: Thank you for playing my little game. The answers you need lie in the wish-magic of an Ahamkara.
where: Mission dc2 The Spine of Keres / Mission end (cache opened)

228.speaker: EMPEROR CALUS
228.text: Welcome, Guardian. I am Calus. I have been waiting for you.
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Mission start

229.speaker: EMPEROR CALUS
229.text: The gardens are lovely this time of year. Pity about the beasts running amuck.
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Zone 2 begins

230.speaker: EMPEROR CALUS
230.text: Join me Guardian. The end awaits us all!
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Boss zone activates

231.speaker: EMPEROR CALUS
231.text: Well played, my Shadow. Seek me further. You've proven yourself worthy.
where: Mission lev1 The Emperor's Throne / Mission end (cache opened)

232.speaker: ERIS MORN
232.text: A great darkness is stirring on the moon. A Guardian recently went dark closeby. Investigate it.
where: Mission m1 The Dark Beyond / Mission start

233.speaker: ERIS MORN
233.text: Eriana. She fought well. Bring her Ghost back to me.
where: Mission m1 The Dark Beyond / Zone 2 cleared

234.speaker: ERIS MORN
234.text: Thank you Guardian. We honor the lost today through combat.
where: Mission m1 The Dark Beyond / Mission end (cache opened)

235.speaker: ERIS MORN
235.text: The Chamber of Night. This is where my fireteam fell.
where: Mission m2 Chamber of Night / Mission start

236.speaker: ERIS MORN
236.text: The wailing of a Deathsinger. Silencing her will break their ranks.
where: Mission m2 Chamber of Night / Zone 2 cleared

237.speaker: ERIS MORN
237.text: This ritual nears its end. But there's a greater evil than Omnigul.
where: Mission m2 Chamber of Night / Mission end (cache opened)

238.speaker: ERIS MORN
238.text: The Hellmouth. Descend and bring light to the darkness.
where: Mission m3 Crota's End / Mission start

239.speaker: ERIS MORN
239.text: Guardian, I request your presence on the moon. Come to me and we will speak.
where: After earth (act transition)

240.speaker: RASPUTIN
240.text: Обнаружен Страж. Предупреждение: флот Кабал стягивается к Марсу.
where: Mission e2 The Last Array / Zone 2 cleared

241.speaker: RASPUTIN
241.text: Наконец-то ты прибыл. Красный Легион должен быть остановлен.
where: Mission r1 The Buried City / Mission start

242.speaker: RASPUTIN
242.text: Внимание! На поверхности Марса зафиксирована активность 9-го класса. Сигнал бедствия 322. Призываем на помощь Стражей со всей Солнечной системы.
where: After moon (act transition)

243.speaker: THE SPIDER
243.text: A little favor, Guardian. A Baron called Araskes has been bleeding my market. Mind the mines.
where: Mission ts1 The Trickster / Mission start

244.speaker: THE SPIDER
244.text: Lovely. One down. Two to go.
where: Mission ts1 The Trickster / Mission end (cache opened)

245.speaker: THE SPIDER
245.text: Fallen Barons are strangling my trade on the Reef. Do a Spider a favor, Guardian.
where: After titan (act transition)

246.speaker: RIVEN
246.text: Welcome, little light. I have many voices. Which one do you want?
where: Mission dc3 The Wishing Chamber / Mission start

247.speaker: RIVEN
where: Mission dc3 The Wishing Chamber / Zone 2 begins

248.speaker: RIVEN
248.text: A throne that cannot be defeated. This wish was granted... you'll find out how.
where: Mission dc3 The Wishing Chamber / Mission end (cache opened)

249.speaker: ASHER MIR
249.text: Assistant! This is where the Traveler last touched. Do not let them taint the data I need.
where: Mission io1 Sacred Ground / Mission start

250.speaker: ASHER MIR
250.text: The Rupture holds. Thank you, my assistant.
where: Mission io1 Sacred Ground / Mission end (cache opened)

251.speaker: PSION HERALD
251.text: The Emperor in Exile salutes the one who ended Ghaul. Come and worship the God-Emperor and you will be at his right hand.
where: After mars (act transition)

252.speaker: KADI 55-30
where: Tower idle chatter

253.speaker: KADI 55-30
where: Tower idle chatter

254.speaker: KADI 55-30
where: Tower postmaster / talk to KADI 55-30
